source_title: UN DESA State of the World Indigenous Peoples Volume VI
unit_or_scope: Indigenous Peoples and climate crisis across seven sociocultural regions
direct_observation: Indigenous Peoples are disproportionately climate affected while managing biodiversity and maintaining deep land and resource relationships
closed_stage: climate exposure stewardship and rights context
missing_stage: named food production nutrition livelihood governance and adaptation outcomes
next_test: follow one territory from climate hazard and rights to food health and governance outcomes

source_title: World Bank Indigenous Peoples Resilience Framework
unit_or_scope: Indigenous Peoples in 16 countries and three continents
direct_observation: Indigenous food systems livelihoods and economies rely on customary production laws and exchange while rights frameworks enable resilience
missing_stage: implementation land security food outcomes finance control and cultural continuity
next_test: compare rights-secure and insecure communities by food health livelihood and self-determination

source_title: FAO CFS HLPE-FSN Indigenous food and knowledge systems report
unit_or_scope: Indigenous food systems and territories globally
direct_observation: Food and knowledge systems connect territorial rights governance knowledge culture and provisioning and recommendations include data sovereignty nutrition and climate adaptation
closed_stage: integrated system model and policy recommendations
missing_stage: co-creation transfer of control and community outcomes
next_test: audit one program for rights consent data sovereignty nutrition and benefit sharing

source_title: FAO Latin America and Caribbean Indigenous food evidence
unit_or_scope: Indigenous communities and women/youth networks in LAC
direct_observation: Communities link biodiversity conservation food security income and ancestral traditions with women and youth livelihood mechanisms
closed_stage: named livelihood knowledge mechanism and regional examples
missing_stage: income distribution nutrition land rights market risk and transmission
next_test: trace women or youth network through food production income diet biodiversity and cultural teaching

unit_or_scope: Indigenous Peoples globally and IFAD-supported programs
direct_observation: Indigenous Peoples face climate impacts poverty and dispossession while holding food and environmental knowledge; self-determination and FPIC are core
missing_stage: project consent benefit sharing implementation quality and accountability
next_test: join FPIC and finance to land access production benefit and grievance outcomes

source_title: IFAD Agricultural Investment for Markets and Nutrition in Solomon Islands
unit_or_scope: more than 18000 intended beneficiaries over six years using Indigenous traditional farming systems
direct_observation: US20 million project intends to improve food security nutrition climate resilience and rural incomes; about one-third of children under five are stunted and more than half of adults are overweight
missing_stage: completed diet income land security women/youth authority health climate adaptation and cultural continuity
evidence_status: official IFAD announcement; planned beneficiaries and mechanism not completed outcomes
next_test: follow participating households through production purchase diet diversity income land access and community governance

source_title: World Bank Cambodia Sustainable Livelihoods for Indigenous Communities Project
unit_or_scope: 20 Indigenous communities more than 600 Indigenous youth and nearly 1200 farmers with named 15-member food-processing team
direct_observation: Trained Indigenous youth launched local-crop food products; 80 percent of trainees formed village groups and nearly 1200 farmers received horticultural support, while refrigeration and drying-machine gaps restrict production to the dry season
missing_stage: year-round production income nutrition food sovereignty gender/youth decision power and durable market access
evidence_status: official World Bank feature; reported skills and enterprise activity without counterfactual or long-term income data
next_test: track named youth groups through equipment receipt production sales income diet and governance after project end

source_title: UN State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World Mapuche Cayún IPAF project
direct_observation: Project improved community food security generated surplus for market sale reinforced economic links with other Mapuche communities and promoted diet diversification traditional cuisine and medicinal herbs
missing_stage: household nutrition land tenure surplus distribution women/youth authority biodiversity and multi-year continuity
evidence_status: official UN food-security evidence summary; positive project account without counterfactual or household-level measures
next_test: follow household diets income land and knowledge transmission with community-defined indicators
